ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) to 35% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region at the distal-lateral edge of the left lobe; vertical low-intensity band adjacent to the median notch on the right lobe; scattered low-intensity streaks and mottled clusters across the central and proximal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees and a depth of roughly 15% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with multiple deep V-shaped and U-shaped indentations across both lobes; extreme structural discontinuity near the distal tip of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit convex curvature; trailing edges demonstrate a general concave sweep towards the median notch, heavily modified by secondary topographical variations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, roughly circular clusters of low-intensity pixels detected near the trailing edge of the left lobe and within the medial low-intensity band of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, large-scale curved linear low-intensity disruption on the mid-left lobe; multiple horizontal linear scratches across the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jaggedness along the entire trailing edge boundary; deep indentation on the distal margin of the right lobe; prominent curved linear scar on the left lobe face.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical dark pigmentation band bordering the right side of the median notch; distinct 'U' shaped linear mark on the left lobe surface.
